data.title: Norway vs Wales Predictions, Picks & Odds - 14/11/2026
data.content: Norway head into this Nations League fixture in solid form, having won three of their last five matches. Ståle Solbakken's side boast an impressive attacking record in this campaign, scoring six goals across four outings. The hosts will, however, be without defender Torbjørn Heggem through suspension following his red card in Cardiff. With Erling Haaland spearheading the attack, Norway carry a genuine threat and will be eager to avenge that 2-1 reverse. [...] Wales did claim a memorable 2-1 victory in Cardiff back in October, so Craig Bellamy's side cannot be dismissed entirely. The returns of Harry Wilson and Joe Rodon strengthen the squad, yet away form remains a concern; a draw and a loss from two road fixtures hardly inspires confidence at this level. Norway will be without suspended defender Torbjørn Heggem, though that alone is unlikely to shift the balance. [...] Wales arrive in a more uncertain state, with just a draw and a defeat from their recent outings. Craig Bellamy's squad has managed a mere two goals in this Nations League group, highlighting their struggles in the final third. The returns of Harry Wilson and Joe Rodon from injury offer a timely boost, while goalkeeper Karl Darlow and Rubin Colwill add further depth. That victory over Norway in October provides belief, though replicating it away from home looks a tall order.

data.content:
Harry Wilson missed the team's last international period through injury, but the 29-year-old is available here and is set to start, while Daniel James could have a role through the middle against Norway.

Chris Mepham and Rubin Colwill are also potentially in line for starts on Saturday.

Norway possible starting lineup:

Selvik; Ryerson, Ajer, Ostigard, Wolfe; Odegaard, Berge, Berg; Bobb, Haaland, Nusa

Wales possible starting lineup: [...] Erling Haaland, meanwhile, is in line to win his 60th cap, and the striker will be looking to add to the 65 goals that he has scored for his country.

As for Wales, Benjamin Cabango and Sorba Thomas are both out of the match through suspension, while six other players are one booking away from being banned for the team's next fixture, including Ethan Ampadu. [...] © Iconsport / Zuma

Two teams still in with a chance of making the quarter-finals of the 2026-27 UEFA Nations League will lock horns on Saturday, with Norway hosting Wales.

Norway have actually lost each of their last three matches in Group A4 to give themselves a mountain to climb, while Wales have been beaten in three of their four games in the competition, but qualification for the final four is still possible at this stage.
